decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY capturing that a wallet is unnecessary for fiat minting but required for affiliate commission payments; the newly listed Transak payment methods do not change reward access.
Transak payment methods and preexisting wallet or crypto requirements do not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
The fiat payment-method clarification does not change the established $15 mint price or no-hidden-fees condition.
Supported Transak payment methods and wallet prerequisites do not alter any primary-sale allocation amount or prize-pool recipient.
The source decision concerns the fiat primary-mint path and leaves secondary-sale royalties and their allocation unchanged.

The candidate already records from the same message that commissions are paid immediately to the recipient wallet; adding card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay to the buyer's mint path does not change commission mechanics.
Fiat payment methods and mint-time wallet requirements do not change badge triggers, destination, or current function.
The FAQ Requirement was introduced from the same complete source message and already requires publishing its fiat-minting and wallet-requirement content.
The statement that fiat buyers need neither preexisting crypto nor a wallet does not alter SIWE authentication for the separate crypto-user mint and transfer flows.
The supported fiat payment methods do not change Small Block prize amounts, draw conditions, or pool funding sources.
Mint-time fiat access does not change the book, referral code, badge, or expired-ticket state transferred with a subsequently sold NFT.
Payment methods and wallet prerequisites do not change the referral code's mint-number identity, permanence, or display locations.
